caption:
The alarm rings for everyone. Not everyone gets up. ⏰

Day 1, same alarm. One gets up and runs. One hits snooze. Day 30, he falls. He gets back up. A year later, the road behind him is the chart. The other snoozed 1,095 times.

The alarm rang for both of them.

Send this to someone who hits snooze.

#morningroutine #discipline #wakeupearly #selfimprovement #motivation
